title: SNU Wild Cherry Nic Pouches by Bar Juice
description: SNU Wild Cherry Nicotine Pouches offer a sophisticated fruit profile for those who appreciate depth and richness. Distinct from candy-sweet alternatives, this flavour captures the essence of ripe, dark cherries, delivering a bold and juicy taste sensation crafted by the flavour masters at Bar Juice 5000. Available in three strengths—9mg (Low), 12mg (Medium), and 18mg (High)—these pouches cater to all preferences, providing a satisfying hit without the use of tobacco. The slim, all-white format ensures that the pouches sit comfortably under the lip, leaving no residue and ensuring complete discretion. Enhancing the experience is SNU's signature "scented can" technology. A quick rub of the lid releases the authentic aroma of wild cherries, setting the stage for the premium flavour inside. Perfect for users looking for a reliable, high-quality nicotine alternative. Nicotine Ranges: Low - 9mg this is best suited for new users Medium - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users High - 18mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, Suck or Swallow the pouches.
